items.note: κυρίου (kuriou) 'Lord' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
εἰσῆλθόν (eisēlthon) 'they entered' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἐξῆλθον (exēlthon) 'have gone out' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἀπολέσωμεν (apolesōmen) 'we may lose' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἀπολέσητε (apolesēte) 'you may lose' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
εἰργάσασθε (eirgasasthe) 'you have worked for' occurs in a few manuscripts (Tyn+Treg) instead of εἰργασάμεθα, (eirgasametha) 'we have worked for,' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+SBL+WH+TR+Byz)
ἀπολάβωμεν (apolabōmen) 'we may receive' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἀπολάβητε. (apolabēte) 'you may receive.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
παραβαίνων (parabainōn) 'is transgressing' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of προάγων (proagōn) 'is progressing' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
τοῦ Χριστοῦ, (tou Christou) 'of the Christ' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
ὑμῶν (humōn) 'of you' occurs in a few manuscripts (SBL+WH+Treg) instead of ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+TR+Byz)
ἀμήν.¶ (amēn) 'Amen.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
